title: Kose reports leak of 28,098 customer records from in-store lesson reservation system
date_note: Kose confirmed the suspicious requests on 2026-11-10; disclosure published 2026-11-19.
geo_basis: Maison KOSE Ginza named as a store whose customers are affected
summary: Kose disclosed that personal data leaked from its reservation system for in-store trials and lessons. According to Security NEXT, the company found repeated requests loading member data on 10 November, and an access-control weakness was used to reach it. The leak covers 28,098 records of customers of Maison KOSE Ginza and the closed Omotesando location.
plain: Cosmetics maker Kose says customer details from its in-store lesson booking system were accessed by an outsider through a weakness in the system.
exec: A reservation system with weak access control exposed customer data; check booking portals for the same flaw.
action: Affected customers: expect Kose's email and watch for phishing using your name and contact details.
impact: 28,098 records: name, address, phone number, date of birth, gender, email address (Security NEXT, per Kose).

validation.note: Security NEXT reports Kose's own disclosure; Kose's notice itself not opened. Unclear if 28,098 is unique people.

review.note: Compared with Security NEXT: 28,098 records, 10 Nov, access-control flaw, Ginza and closed Omotesando, fields, published 19 Nov
